'''''Peperomia caperata''''', the '''emerald ripple peperomia''', is a [[species]] of [[flowering plant]] in the [[Family (taxonomy)|family]] [[Piperaceae]], [[native plant|native]] to Brazil. It is a mound-forming [[evergreen]] [[perennial plant|perennial]] growing to {{convert|20|cm|0|abbr=on}} tall and wide, with corrugated heart-shaped leaves, and narrow spikes of white flowers {{convert|5|-|8|cm|0|abbr=on}} long, in summer.<ref name=RHSAZ>{{cite book|title=RHS A-Z encyclopedia of garden plants|year=2008|publisher=Dorling Kindersley|location=United Kingdom|isbn=978-1405332965|pages=1136}}</ref>

With a minimum temperature requirement of {{convert|15|C|F|abbr=on}}, ''P. caperata'' must be grown indoors in most [[temperateness|temperate]] regions.<ref name="AGM Plants">{{cite web | url = https://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/pdfs/agm-lists/agm-ornamentals.pdf | title = AGM Plants - Ornamental | date = July 2017 | page = 75 | publisher = Royal Horticultural Society | accessdate = 22 April 2018}}</ref>

== Cultivars ==
''Peperomia caperata'' is a popular [[houseplant]].  Numerous [[cultivars]] have been developed, of which 'Luna Red' has gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]].<ref>{{cite web | url = https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/20612/Peperomia-caperata-Luna-Red/Details | title = ''Peperomia caperata'' 'Luna Red' | publisher = RHS | access-date = 18 January 2021}}</ref><ref name="AGM Plants"/>
